We at Screen Magic are compliant with the following data privacy certifications. These allow us to follow proper data security with respect to industrial standard policies.

- ISO 27001:2013
- HIPAA
- GDPR

Data Security Guidelines for SMS-Magic iOS/Android Application:

- SMS-Magic application doesn’t require access to voice and data communication
- No permission is required to Email, calendar, web browser, web activities, and contacts
- Application is based on mission-specific information
- No PII collection other than signup requirements
- Security tested with respect to all possible attacks
- End-to-End data encryption in transit
- Full data encryption at rest
- Secure APIs implemented
- No data cache on the local storage of the device

For compliance-related queries, contact our security experts at [security@screen-magic.com](mailto:security@screen-magic.com)
